name: Feature Lab
blurb: Suggest ideas and vote on them.
checks: Open Feature Lab from the Community menu and sort the ideas by Most voted.
Tap Post an idea, type a short title and a description, then close the form without posting.
Vote for someone else's idea, then tap again to remove your vote.
Open an idea and check its history and comments load.
Switch the view to Roadmap and find an idea that's Planned or In progress.
